summary: Forest Service steel lookout about 50 ft high in Oregon County, MO, described by the Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1956; no later source describes it.

facts.design: Steel skeleton framework with a small house mounted on top
facts.status_note: Last described in a 1956 survey record; no source found describes its condition since.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mark Twain National Forest)

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed and described the tower. The survey record gives no construction date.

evidence.supports: U.S. Forest Service lookout tower located about 14.5 miles east-northeast of Alton
evidence.quote: ABOUT 14-1/2 MILES EAST-NORTHEAST OF ALTON, 2-3/4 MILES

evidence.supports: Station is a U.S. Forest Service lookout tower
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS A U.S. FOREST SERVICE LOOKOUT TOWER LOCATED

evidence.supports: 2.75 miles north-northwest of the Bradley post office
evidence.quote: NORTH-NORTHWEST OF THE BRADLEY POST OFFICE

evidence.quote: SKELETON FRAMEWORK WITH A SMALL HOUSE MOUNTED ON TOP.

Steel tower with no other improvements on the site
Mark Twain National Forest named for the site

notes_for_editor: Brief height 15.2 m matches the survey's 'about 50 feet'. No source found on staffing, fires, access, or current condition. nhlr.org Windy page returned 404. firetower.org Missouri former-site register lists only Grassy and Gypsy, so this tower is not on it. A web search for a tower named Windy in Oregon County found nothing; the Missouri Conservationist article read is general (state-wide tower numbers) and was not used.
